gui.robotica.industry_use_tip: FE/t it draws right now. The Mk and speed cards raise it, efficiency cards lower it
jei.robotica.info.depleted_fuel_pellet: Waste of a burned fuel pellet, from the RTG or a fission reactor. Put it in a Centrifuge: thorium dust back, sometimes graphite, and a 10% chance of a Radiant Isotope.
jei.robotica.info.pyrolite_ore: Found in Nether netherrack, more of it in basalt deltas. Drops a Pyrolite Shard. Needs an iron pickaxe.
jei.robotica.info.resonite_ore: Found in end stone on the outer End islands (not the main island). Rare. Drops a Resonite Crystal. Needs a diamond pickaxe.
jei.robotica.info.thorium_fuel_pellet: RTG fuel: %s FE/t for %s minutes, one pellet at a time. Also fuel for the fission reactor, which gets more out of it.
jei.robotica.info.thorium_ore: Found in the Overworld from Y -48 to 32 (most around Y -8), in stone and deepslate. Common enough to mine by hand. Drops Raw Thorium.
tooltip.robotica.alloy_smelter_mk1.detai:
Makes the Robotica alloys: up to three inputs, one result.
Right-click it with ingots, or feed it with hoppers (one item kind per input slot).
Cards: speed, efficiency.
tooltip.robotica.alloy_smelter_mk2.detai:
Makes the Robotica alloys: up to three inputs, one result.
Right-click it with ingots, or feed it with hoppers (one item kind per input slot).
Cards: speed, efficiency, fortune.

tooltip.robotica.assembler: Builds parts from plates and circuits
tooltip.robotica.assembler_mk1.details:
Builds parts from up to six inputs: some exist only here, others cost less than at the crafting table.
The bigger parts need a lot of FE.
Cards: speed, efficiency.
tooltip.robotica.assembler_mk2.details:
Builds parts from up to six inputs: some exist only here, others cost less than at the crafting table.
The bigger parts need a lot of FE.
Cards: speed, efficiency, fortune (recipes that allow it).

tooltip.robotica.centrifuge_mk1.details:
Splits one input into up to four results, some by chance.
Depleted Fuel Pellets give thorium back and, rarely, a Radiant Isotope.
Cards: speed, efficiency, void.
tooltip.robotica.centrifuge_mk2.details:

Cards: speed, efficiency, fortune (recipes that allow it), void.

tooltip.robotica.deepslate_thorium_ore.d:
Overworld, Y -48 to 32, most around Y -8.
Drops Raw Thorium. Smelt it, or grind it for more.
tooltip.robotica.depleted_fuel_pellet.de:
Waste of the RTG and the reactor.
The Centrifuge gets thorium dust back, and sometimes a Radiant Isotope.
tooltip.robotica.enriched_fuel_pellet.de:
Reactor fuel: two and a half times the heat of a thorium pellet.
Leaves a Depleted Fuel Pellet.
tooltip.robotica.ferrothorium_ingot.deta: Alloy Smelter: iron + thorium. The Age 2 alloy.
tooltip.robotica.graphite_dust.details:
Ground coal or charcoal (Grinder, or a Tinker's Hammer in the crafting grid).
Moderator for fuel pellets, part of the Superconductor Coil.
tooltip.robotica.industry_upgrade: Right-click the placed previous Mk with this to upgrade it in place
tooltip.robotica.pyrolite_ore.details:
Nether netherrack, richest in basalt deltas.
Drops a Pyrolite Shard. Needs an iron pickaxe.
tooltip.robotica.pyrosteel_ingot.details: Alloy Smelter: ferrothorium + pyrolite + blaze powder. The Age 3 alloy.
tooltip.robotica.radiant_isotope.details:
A rare Centrifuge result from Depleted Fuel Pellets (10%).
Needed for Fusion Fuel Pellets.
tooltip.robotica.resonant_alloy_ingot.de: Alloy Smelter: pyrosteel + resonite + ender pearl. The Age 4 alloy.
tooltip.robotica.resonant_lattice.detail: Made only in the Assembler. Age 4.
tooltip.robotica.resonite_ore.details:
End stone on the outer End islands. Rare.
Drops a Resonite Crystal. Needs a diamond pickaxe.
tooltip.robotica.rtg: Thorium Fuel Pellets: %s FE/t, passive and quiet
tooltip.robotica.rtg.details:
Put Thorium Fuel Pellets in. One decays at a time, quietly, for 150 FE/t.
Pushes FE into blocks touching it; a Tesla Coil on it sends it further.
tooltip.robotica.superconductor_coil.det: Made only in the Assembler. Age 3.
tooltip.robotica.thermocouple.details: Made only in the Assembler. Turns heat into power: the heart of the RTG.
tooltip.robotica.thorium_dust.details: Smelts into a Thorium Ingot. Two make a Thorium Fuel Pellet in the Assembler.
tooltip.robotica.thorium_fuel_pellet.det:
Burns in the RTG (150 FE/t for 20 minutes) or a fission reactor.
Leaves a Depleted Fuel Pellet.
tooltip.robotica.thorium_ore.details:
Overworld, Y -48 to 32, most around Y -8.
Drops Raw Thorium. Smelt it, or grind it for more.
